summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 new customer flows (Wallet, Refer&Earn, PIN serviceability, Pay-with-Wallet at checkout, Live order tracking) + light regression. All 4 primary flows are functionally working end-to-end against the live backend. Regression (SAVE10 coupon + home/products/cart) also green. One minor uncaught-promise issue found on the Referral page copy/share buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() calls in copy() and share() are not wrapped in try/catch. In browsers where clipboard permission is denied (or navigator.share is unavailable AND clipboard is blocked), a NotAllowedError bubbles up as an uncaught promise rejection and shows the React dev error overlay. Toast still fires so end user notices little in prod build, but it should be handled gracefully.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (console warning). Non-blocking accessibility warning.

action_items: (LOW) Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText() calls in Referral.js (copy() and share() functions) in try/catch to prevent uncaught NotAllowedError when clipboard permission is denied.
(OPTIONAL) Add aria-describedby (or a DialogDescription) to LocationModal DialogContent to remove Radix accessibility console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Referral.js copy()/share() do not handle rejected clipboard promises; will surface as red error overlay in dev.
Wallet.js does not have loading error branch — if /me/wallet fails, page stays on skeleton forever. Consider try/catch + retry.
All new pages correctly use data-testid attributes as required. Good separation. No MongoDB ObjectId leaks observed in API responses.
